description:
Dry-run any priced HTTP 402 capability against deterministic sandbox fixtures with real input validation and live production pricing. Use this to test schemas at zero cost before funding; do not use for live data (x402_execute_capability) or multi-item quotes (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: omit arguments to auto-fill valid example defaults, or supply custom arguments to test real contract validation.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, zero GPU compute; returns sandbox=true fixture, HTTP 422 on invalid args, HTTP 404 on unknown capability, 120 req/min/IP.

arguments.description: Optional JSON arguments matching the capability input_schema. Omit to auto-fill valid example defaults; pass custom fields to verify 422 validation.

capability_id.description: Priced capability_id or route key from x402_list_capabilities to dry-run (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "kb_search", or "POST /switchboard/chunk").

name: x402_preview_capability

charged.description: Always false because sandbox previews never debit funds.

ok.description: True when the sandbox dry-run succeeded.

production_pricing.description: Live production pricing for this capability when executed with a funded spend key.

result.description: Deterministic sandbox response fixture matching the production contract.

sandbox.description: Always true indicating deterministic fixture output rather than live production data.

used_example_defaults.description: True when example default arguments were auto-filled.

title: Preview Capability in Sandbox
